title: Map context
description: v1 contract (maps connection step 2, owner directive D-090-R124) for the ONE document the E-07 location and zoning map renderers consume via app.drawings.maps.adapter.load_map_context. It is reshaped NYC city open data only - the subject lot outline (MapPLUTO / DOF Digital Tax Map), the surrounding zoning-district boundaries (DCP NYC GIS Zoning Features nyzd, field ZONEDIST) and the surrounding building footprints (OTI Building Footprints, NYC Open Data 5zhs-2jue) - never a live service call. The maps are APPROXIMATE: they are drawn from the city tax map, they are NEVER a boundary survey, and the zoning layer is NEVER a lot-level zoning determination (the official use limitation and the +/- 20 ft accuracy note ride on every zoning map). Every coordinate is EPSG:2263 (NAD83 / New York Long Island, US survey feet) - the authoritative measurement CRS; the maps never reproject and refuse any other CRS. The schema demands per-layer provenance on every drawable (available) layer so nothing unsourced is ever drawn; the adapter ignores provenance (it validates geometry and strings), so the two are complementary, not redundant. Structural rules a schema cannot state - ring closure, simplicity, non-degeneracy, holes inside their exterior, XML-1.0-safe strings - are enforced by the adapter, which fails closed; this schema pins the shape, the single CRS, the caps and the vocabulary so a document rejected by one is rejected by the other.

contract_version.description: CLOSED enum of published map_context contract versions. 1.0.0 = the initial shape (D-090-R124). 1.1.0 = adds three OPTIONAL members to map_context for the report's site-context maps (D-090-R936/R937, task M5-T154): context_window, tax_lots and streets; every 1.0.0 document stays valid unchanged. Append-only: a new version is admitted only by an accepted contract task that appends to this enum.

document_kind.description: Fixed document-kind discriminator so a consumer can tell a map_context document apart from any other contract document.

map_context.description: The drawable context itself. Named exactly 'map_context' because the adapter reads doc['map_context'] and nothing else at the top level (contract_version/document_kind/_expected_failure are the envelope, invisible to the renderer).

_expected_failure.description: FIXTURE-ONLY annotation stating the intended defect of an invalid fixture (packages/contracts README convention). Admitted here so an invalid fixture fails ONLY for its stated defect, never for carrying the annotation; producers NEVER emit this key (app/contracts/study_contracts.py rejects it anywhere in a real document).

map_context.description: Everything the location map and the zoning map need, validated and fail-closed. The subject lot is always present (the study is about it); each surrounding layer is either drawable (available, with its sources) or not_available carrying the data's own reason, so the map returns an honest 'unavailable' rather than a blank or invented layer.

crs.description: The single supported CRS: EPSG:2263 (NAD83 / New York Long Island, US survey feet), the authoritative citywide measurement CRS. Equals app.drawings.maps.adapter.SUPPORTED_CRS; any other CRS (e.g. an EPSG:4326 display CRS) is refused, never silently misplaced.

units.description: Linear unit of every coordinate: US survey feet (EPSG:2263).

measurement.description: The measurement rank and its one-to-one display label for these maps - for the tax-map-derived outline this is rank 'approximate_tax_map', label 'Approximate - tax map' (the dash shown here is an em dash in the data). Reused from site_fact exactly as results.schema.json reuses it, so the label is the shared vocabulary, never retyped. An 'unknown' rank is not a valid map measurement.

zoning_districts.description: The zoning-district layer: either drawable (available) with its districts, the three mandatory notes and provenance, or not_available carrying the data's own reason.

building_footprints.description: The building-footprint layer: either drawable (available) with its footprints, attribution and provenance, or not_available carrying the data's own reason.

context_window.description: OPTIONAL (contract 1.1.0, task M5-T154). The EPSG:2263 box the building footprints and the neighbouring tax lots were fetched for: the subject lot's bounding box plus a padding (the report uses the lot's bbox + 400 ft). Finite numbers in the document's CRS. A 1.0.0 document omits it.

tax_lots.description: OPTIONAL (contract 1.1.0, task M5-T154). The neighbouring tax lots inside context_window, so the lot is drawn among its neighbours: either drawable (available) with its lots, attribution and provenance, or not_available carrying the data's own reason. The subject lot is NEVER an entry; no owner name or any personal field is requested or stored. A 1.0.0 document omits it.

streets.description: OPTIONAL (contract 1.1.0, task M5-T154). The named street centre lines in a wider window around the lot (the report uses the lot's bbox + 1,000 ft): either drawable (available) with its centre lines, attribution and provenance, or not_available carrying the data's own reason. A 1.0.0 document omits it.

subject_lot.description: The lot the study is about - the focus of both maps, drawn from its own tax-map outline independently of the district polygons. The outline is APPROXIMATE (tax map), never a boundary survey.

bbl.description: Borough-Block-Lot label read from the data (OPTIONAL: the data may carry no BBL). When present, the location map labels the lot with it.

outline.description: The lot polygon (exterior ring first, then any holes), EPSG:2263 US survey feet.

zoning_available.description: A drawable zoning layer. Carries the three notes every zoning map must show - the dataset attribution, the horizontal-accuracy statement and the official use limitation - and the per-layer provenance so nothing unsourced is drawn.

entries.description: The zoning districts around the lot. Capped at 2000 entries, equal to app.drawings.maps.adapter.MAX_MAP_FEATURES (the adapter rejects more).

attribution.description: Dataset attribution read from the data, e.g. crediting DCP NYC GIS Zoning Features (nyzd) under the NYC Open Data Terms of Use, with the source edit date.

accuracy.description: The horizontal-accuracy statement read from the data (the DCP +/- 20 ft statement), so a boundary drawn near the lot is understood as approximate, not a lot-level determination.

use_limitation.description: The official DCP use limitation, quoted verbatim from docs/samples/maps/README.md: "These features are not intended for determining zoning at the individual tax lot level". It MUST appear on every zoning map; the map is deliberately not a lot-level zoning determination.

buildings_available.description: A drawable building-footprint layer: neighbourhood context footprints with the dataset attribution and the per-layer provenance so nothing unsourced is drawn.

entries.description: The building footprints around the lot. Capped at 2000 entries, equal to app.drawings.maps.adapter.MAX_MAP_FEATURES (the adapter rejects more).

attribution.description: Dataset attribution read from the data, crediting the OTI Building Footprints dataset (NYC Open Data 5zhs-2jue) under the NYC Open Data Terms of Use, with the source edit date.

layer_unavailable.description: A layer the data could not provide. The corresponding map becomes an honest 'unavailable' carrying this reason - never a blank or invented layer. Provenance is optional here (there may be nothing retrieved to source).

reason.description: The data's own plain-English reason the layer is unavailable (shown on the map).

reason_kind.description: Machine kind of the reason, reusing the kind the E-07 renderers and fixtures use: 'source_unavailable' (the layer could not be retrieved from its service for this area). CLOSED enum; new kinds are appended additively only by an accepted contract task.

zoning_entry.description: One zoning-district polygon, labelled by its verbatim ZONEDIST designation. All districts share one neutral wash on the map; the ZONEDIST symbol is the only classification and it is the label (the use limitation forbids a lot-level determination).

zonedist.description: The verbatim ZONEDIST designation read from the data (e.g. 'R7A', 'C4-4A', 'M1-5'), used as the district label.

outline.description: The district polygon, EPSG:2263 US survey feet.

building_entry.description: One building footprint, drawn as neighbourhood context (not labelled individually). An optional source identifier (object_id / doitt_id / bin) may travel with it; the renderer ignores it (it draws only the outline).

outline.description: The footprint polygon, EPSG:2263 US survey feet.

object_id.description: OPTIONAL source feature id as served (e.g. the ArcGIS OBJECTID as a string).

doitt_id.description: OPTIONAL OTI/DOITT building-footprint id as served (a string).

bin.description: OPTIONAL 7-digit NYC Building Identification Number for the footprint.

window_box.description: An axis-aligned EPSG:2263 box (US survey feet): the extent the surrounding layers were fetched for. Finite numbers; each bounded by app.drawings.maps.adapter.MAX_ABS_COORD_FT (1e8 ft) exactly like a map point. The adapter additionally rejects non-finite values; xmin<xmax and ymin<ymax are the builder's concern (a schema cannot compare siblings).

tax_lots_available.description: A drawable neighbouring-tax-lot layer: the lots around the subject (the subject itself is never an entry) with the dataset attribution and the per-layer provenance so nothing unsourced is drawn.

entries.description: The neighbouring tax lots. Capped at 2000 entries, equal to app.drawings.maps.adapter.MAX_MAP_FEATURES.

attribution.description: Dataset attribution read from the data, crediting DCP MapPLUTO under the NYC Open Data Terms of Use, with the source edit date.

tax_lot_entry.description: One neighbouring tax lot, labelled by its BBL. The outline is the source MapPLUTO outline unchanged (approximate - tax map), EPSG:2263 US survey feet.

bbl.description: The lot's Borough-Block-Lot label read from the data.

address.description: OPTIONAL street address of the lot as served (a non-empty string).

outline.description: The lot polygon (exterior ring first, then the source's remaining rings), EPSG:2263 US survey feet, verbatim from MapPLUTO.

streets_available.description: A drawable street-centre-line layer: the named mapped street centre lines in the streets window, with the dataset attribution and the per-layer provenance so nothing unsourced is drawn.

window.description: The EPSG:2263 box the street centre lines were fetched for (the report uses the lot's bbox + 1,000 ft).

entries.description: The street centre lines in the window. Capped at 2000 entries, equal to app.drawings.maps.adapter.MAX_MAP_FEATURES.

attribution.description: Dataset attribution read from the data, crediting DCP Digital City Map (DCM) Street Center Line under the NYC Open Data Terms of Use, with the source edit date.

street_entry.description: One street centre line: its name, the raw source width text and the mapped width in feet ONLY when that text is one plain number (D-052; '60-75' or any other text is null), and its polyline paths verbatim in EPSG:2263.

name.description: The street name read from the data (DCM Street_NM).

width_text.description: The source mapped-width text (DCM Streetwidth) UNCHANGED, or null when the source carries none. Free text; may be empty.

mapped_width_ft.description: The mapped street width in feet, a number ONLY when width_text is one plain number such as '60' or '100'; '60-75', '<=75' or any other text gives null (D-052). Not a wide/narrow classification.

paths.description: The street centre line's polyline paths, each a line of at least two points, EPSG:2263 US survey feet, verbatim from the source.

line.description: One polyline path: at least two [x, y] points in EPSG:2263 US survey feet (a centre line, never a closed ring).

provenance.description: Per-layer provenance: where this layer's features came from. REQUIRED on every available (drawable) layer so nothing unsourced is ever drawn; OPTIONAL on a not_available layer. The adapter ignores it; the schema demands it (backend-api rule: a material value with no provenance is a defect).

source_id.description: Stable id of the source in the source registry (fixtures use 'test-fixture-synthetic').

dataset_id.description: Dataset identifier, e.g. the zoning features layer 'nyzd' or the building-footprints NYC Open Data id '5zhs-2jue'.

request_url.description: The exact request URL the features were retrieved from (fixtures use an example.invalid test-fixture-synthetic URL - no network was called).

retrieved_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the layer was retrieved.

raw_digest_sha256.description: Canonical content digest of the retrieved payload ('sha256:' + 64 lowercase hex), so the drawn features are traceable to an exact response.

source_data_last_edited.description: RFC 3339 full-date of the source's own last edit (the dataset's edit date), distinct from retrieved_at.

dataset_version.description: The dataset version the features came from (fixtures use 'test-fixture-synthetic').

point.description: [x, y] in EPSG:2263 US survey feet. Each coordinate's absolute value is bounded by app.drawings.maps.adapter.MAX_ABS_COORD_FT (1e8 ft) - NYC values are ~1e6 ft; far beyond is corrupt data. The adapter additionally rejects non-finite values.

ring.description: One polygon ring. At least 4 points so a closed ring (first point repeated as last) has at least 3 distinct vertices; at most 2048 points, equal to app.drawings.maps.adapter.MAX_RING_POINTS (which bounds the adapter's O(n^2) simplicity check). CLOSURE (first == last), SIMPLICITY (no self-touch/cross) and NON-DEGENERACY (encloses area) are enforced by the adapter, not by this schema (JSON Schema cannot compare array elements).

polygon.description: A polygon as rings: the exterior ring first, then any holes. The adapter checks every hole lies inside the exterior ring.
